title: The Tonic Triad band and rehearsals at Co-operators Hall
summary: He describes Professor Pritchett's symphonic band and its rehearsals at Co-operators Hall near Hope Hall.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You ever play in any other brass bands, however, besides the St. John and the Gibson and the... The Puxedo, how did you say?

Well, I played with the Tonic Tribe. There was Professor Pritchett, he had a band. Did they get out and march or is that... Well, at the time when Jesse Orange run at the fairground at the Jefferson Track, where we had the band then. We'd get one night, but it was a flop. But what he had, he had something good, but if the money was to pay it off. See, in that type of music we played, there wasn't no money paying off in there. Wasn't that a great big band? Like a big symphonic band? Yes, that's right. That's what it was.

Tonic Tribe. Tonic Tribe. Yeah, like going home and all them big marches, Tang Heys, Part 1, Part 2. I had one number there with a 52 bar layout before I come in on it. You know that. You know that. 52 bar layout? 52 bar before I'd done anything. Yeah. Yeah, but when I'd come in, I'd be right ready. I'd be right ready.
Was that the band that rehearsed over at the Tulane Club? No, but we had-
Who was that that had the money? No, we used to be rehearsed at the Corporate's Hall.
Oh, down there. I can get stuff on that.
We used to be at the Corporate's Hall. We had Talbot, a couple of Mormons.
Is that still around the Corporate's Hall?

Still around the Corporate's Hall? Still around the Corporate's Hall. Still around the Corporate's Hall. What is that about that? There's a church now. Yeah. Hope Hall used to be- Yeah, it'd be a good-
Hope Hall. What is the address there?
That ought to be right around- Trimay or Liberty, they call it Trimay now. Yeah, down the Trimay section.
You've seen it. Oh yeah, I know it, but I do know the address.
Yeah, it's between Dumain and what? Between Dumain and St. Philip, I'd say.
Yeah, yeah. From Dumain and St. Philip, yeah. On the Riverside. The Riverside.
So that's where they rehearsed, the Big Bang. Yeah, that's where we rehearsed, right there.
